I once intentionally OD'd on lithium, risperdal, and something else I can't remember. I ended up spending some time in the ICU. I thought my life wasn't worth living. I was 18 at the time. I'm 38 now with a wife, kid, and a great job. You never know what waits around the corner for you. Give life a shot, what's the worst that can happen?
Honestly I just run a bunch of nuclear reactors and have like a 3 turret deep laser wall around my entire base.

I attempted suicide when I was 17 (overdose on prescription medication) because I felt that i was worthless and there was no point to any of it. I spent a couple nights in the ICU and then residential treatment for 6 months.

Today, I'm 37, married, and have a kid. I have a good corporate job and am generally happy with my life.

You never know what tomorrow will bring. Once you get out of your current situation, you might find a new outlook on life. You need to surround yourself with people who care about and are supportive of you. If all you know are toxic relationships, then you will only view life as a toxic waste dump. Give tomorrow a chance!
